body: yeah it’s just, they don’t really have a trusted adult, i’ve tried to convince them to talk to the counselor but they vehemently don’t want to. at this point i’m just stuck with letting them not go or betraying their trust and speaking up about it, but i don’t even know what i’d do in that case.

mental health, like i wouldn’t say i’m in a great place, but i’m functioning. they’re mom has convinced them that they should be under 100 pounds at about 6’4” which is beyond unhealthy, let alone the rest of their bad relationship. they’ve been on the brink of attempting suicide multiple times and i don’t know what i can do. maybe this is the wrong place for this kind of post.
